line.title: TRIBUNAL ROTAE ROMANAE
line.courtDescription: DA TRIBUNAL ROTAE ROMANAE SITS IN {venue}. {gallery} ARCHMAGISTRATE {judge} PRESIDES. DA COURT ASSIGNS {interpreter} TA RENDER DA BENCH'S LATIN!

venues: DA HALL OF DA ROTA, UNDER A FRESCO OF DA LAST JUDGEMENT
A VAULTED CHAMBER OF DA APOSTOLIC PALACE, LIT BY A SINGLE WINDOW
A COLD COURTROOM OF GREY MARBLE, WIT DA EMPIRE'S KEYS CARVED OVER DA BENCH
DA CHAPTER HOUSE OF A CATHEDRAL, CLEARED OF ITS PEWS FOR DA HEARIN'
gallery: CLERICS IN BLACK FILL DA BENCHES AN' DO NO WHISPER!
A ROW OF NOTARIES WRITES DOWN EVERY WORD IN THREE COPIES!
DA GALLERY IZ EMPTY: DA ROTA DOES NO SIT FOR AN AUDIENCE!
TWO SWISS HALBERDIERS STAND AT DA DOOR AN' LOOK AT NUTTIN'!

la: Nulla accusatio in tabula scripta est. Tribunal non sedet. Discede.
tr: DERE IZ NO CHARGE WRITTEN ON DA SHEET. DA COURT DOES NO SIT. YOU MAY GO!

la: Tribunal Rotae Romanae sedet. Adstat reus {name}. Audiatur et altera pars, sed lex non flectitur.
In nomine Imperii Sancti, causa {name} aperitur. Iustitia aequa est, sed non mitis.
Sedet Rota. Reus {name}, attende: hic nihil fortuna, omnia lex.
tr: DA TRIBUNAL OF DA ROMAN ROTA IZ IN SESSION. DA ACCUSED, {name}, STANDS BEFORE IT. DA OTHER SIDE SHALL BE HEARD, BUT DA LAW DOES NO BEND!
IN DA NAME OF DA HOLY EMPIRE, DA CASE OF {name} IZ OPENED. JUSTICE HERE IZ FAIR, BUT IT IZ NO GENTLE!
DA ROTA SITS. ACCUSED {name}, LISTEN: NUTTIN' HERE IZ LEFT TA CHANCE, EVERYTINK TA DA LAW!

la: Advocatus non admittitur. Interpres tibi datus est; nihil aliud.
Nemo pro te loquetur. Interpres verba mea reddet, et tua.
tr: NO ADVOCATE IZ ADMITTED. YOU HAB BIN GIVEN AN INTERPRETER, AN' NUTTIN' MORE!
NOBODY WILL SPEAK FOR YOU. DA INTERPRETER WILL RENDER ME WORDS, AN' YA!

la: Accusaris de crimine: {charge}. Poena in tabula: {amount}.
Scriptum est in tabula: {charge}. Pretium: {amount}.
tr: YOU IZ ACCUSED OF: {charge}. DA PENALTY ON DA SHEET: {amount}!
IT IZ WRITTEN ON DA SHEET: {charge}. ITS PRICE: {amount}!

la: Quid respondes? Confiteris, an negas?
tr: WHAT DO YOU ANSWER? DO YOU CONFESS, OR DO YOU DENY?

la: Misericordia non est in hoc foro. Responde ad accusationem.
Misericordiam a solo Deo pete. Confiteris, an negas?
tr: DERE IZ NO MERCY IN DIS COURT. ANSWER DA CHARGE!
ASK GOD ALONE FOR MERCY. DO YOU CONFESS, OR DO YOU DENY?

la: Confessio accepta est. Poena uno gradu minuitur, nec amplius.
tr: DA CONFESSION IZ ACCEPTED. DA SENTENCE IZ LOWERED BY ONE STEP ON DA TARIFF, AN' NO FURTHER!

la: Quod es in tabula scriptum est. De hoc non disputatur.
tr: WHAT IZ WRITTEN ON DA SHEET IZ WHAT YOU IZ. DAT IZ NO OPEN TA ARGUMENT!

la: Interpres tibi dicet quanta sit spes defensionis tuae. Nihil celatur.
tr: DA COURT STATES DA ODDS PLAINLY, SO NOBODY CAN CALL IT UNFAIR: YA DEFENCE CARRIES {chance} IN A HUNDRED. IF IT FAILS, DA DENIAL IZ PERJURY, AN' DA SENTENCE RISES ONE STEP!

la: Loquere. Rota audit.
tr: SPEAK. DA ROTA IZ LISTENIN'!

la: Accusatio non probata est. Absolvo te. Tabula deletur.
Defensio valet. Absolutus es; discede in pace.
tr: DA CHARGE IZ NO PROVEN. ME ACQUIT YOU. DA SHEET IZ STRUCK OUT!
DA DEFENCE HOLDS. YOU IZ ACQUITTED; GO IN PEACE!

la: Negasti quod verum est. Periurium addis crimini tuo.
Defensio cecidit, et mendacium tuum cum ea. Poena augetur.
tr: YOU DENIED WHAT IZ TRUE. YOU ADD PERJURY TA YA CRIME!
DA DEFENCE HAB FALLEN, AN' YA LIE WIT IT. DA SENTENCE IZ RAISED!

la: Reus est. Condemno.
Probatum est. Condemno te secundum legem.
tr: GUILTY. ME CONDEMN YOU.
IT IZ PROVEN. ME CONDEMN YOU ACCORDIN' TA DA LAW!

la: Poenam tibi irrogo secundum tariffam Imperii.
tr: ME PASS SENTENCE ACCORDIN' TA DA EMPIRE'S TARIFF: {sentence}!

la: Bona tua publicantur, usque ad summam poenae.
tr: YA GOODS IZ CONFISCATED, UP TA DA FULL SUM OF DA PENALTY: {amount}!

release: DA CELL DOOR OPENS. A CLERIC READS DA RELEASE ALOUD IN LATIN, DEN ONCE MORE FOR YOU. DA ROTA DOES NO SEE YOU OUT!
SENTENTIA EXPLETA EST. YA SENTENCE IZ SERVED. DA GUARDS RETURN WHAT LIL' DA COURT LEFT YOU!
DA INTERPRETER WAITS AT DA GATE: "DA ROTA CONSIDERS DA MATTER CLOSED. IT ALSO REMEMBERS IT."
